mapper.sql: SELECT t.id,t.task_no,t.task_name,t.description,t.repository_id,r.repository_name,r.source_type AS repository_source_type,r.original_file_name AS repository_file_name,r.scan_source_type,COALESCE(s.application,r.application) AS application,COALESCE(s.version_no,r.version_no) AS version_no,t.scope_json,t.task_type,t.owner_user_id,t.owner_user_name,t.current_snapshot_id,t.current_run_id,s.snapshot_version,m.id AS manifest_id,t.manifest_status,t.manifest_file_count,t.status,t.total_files,t.completed_files,t.success_files,t.failed_files,t.issue_count,t.cancel_requested,t.error_message,t.schedule_type,t.schedule_time,t.operator_user_id,t.operator_user_name,t.start_time,t.end_time,t.create_time,t.update_time FROM scan_task t JOIN code_repository r ON r.id=t.repository_id LEFT JOIN task_snapshot s ON s.id=t.current_snapshot_id LEFT JOIN task_scan_manifest m ON m.id=(SELECT MAX(mx.id) FROM task_scan_manifest mx WHERE mx.task_snapshot_id=t.current_snapshot_id)
mapper.select: ORDER BY t.create_time DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM scan_task t JOIN code_repository r ON r.id=t.repository_id LEFT JOIN task_snapshot s ON s.id=t.current_snapshot_id

SELECT r.id,r.rule_code,r.rule_name,r.description,r.rule_type,r.target_type,r.risk_level,r.match_type,r.match_content,r.case_sensitive,r.file_types,r.exclude_patterns,r.issue_description,r.suggestion,r.prompt_content,r.enabled,r.deleted,r.create_time,r.update_time FROM scan_rule r JOIN task_rule tr ON tr.rule_id=r.id WHERE tr.task_id=#{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE scan_task SET status='QUEUED',cancel_requested=FALSE,error_message=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE scan_task SET status='RUNNING',start_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,end_time=NULL,total_files=0,completed_files=0,success_files=0,failed_files=0,issue_count=0,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='QUEUED'

UPDATE scan_task SET cancel_requested=TRUE,status=CASE WHEN status='RUNNING' THEN 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' ELSE 'CANCELLED' END,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')

UPDATE scan_task SET completed_files=completed_files+1,success_files=success_files+CASE WHEN #{success} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,failed_files=failed_files+CASE WHEN #{success} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,issue_count=issue_count+#{issues},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM scan_task WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE task_file SET status=#{status},issue_count=#{issues},error_message=#{error},end_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND relative_path=#{path}
